question: ‘Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav’ started how many weeks before the 15th August 2023 celebration?
solution:
The correct answer is __**75 weeks **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Ministry of Culture, Government of India, has launched the “Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav” mobile app.
 
• This initiative celebrates and commemorates 75 years of India’s independence and the remarkable history, culture, and achievements of its people.
 
• The Mahotsav is dedicated to all Indians who have played a pivotal role in shaping the nation’s journey and hold the potential to realize Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s vision of an Aatmanirbhar Bharat.
 
• The official journey of Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav commenced on 12th March 2021 and will culminate on 15th August 2023.
 
• The app provides access to information related to various events and campaigns under this historic celebration
